title: Sources: Anthropic is in early talks to raise at least $30B at a $900B+ valuation; the round is expected to close as soon as the end of this month (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic is in early talks to raise at least $30B at a $900B+ valuation; the round is expected to close as soon as the end of this month — Anthropic PBC is in early talks with investors to raise at least $30 billion in fresh financing, according to people familiar with the matter …
